name: Memory Hole
description: Anyone looking into the hole has memories sucked from their head.
disable: DC 29 Deception check (master) to feed the pit false thoughts that plug it, or DC 28 Occultism check (expert) or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 27) to drain the pit's magic
reset: The trap resets after 1 hour if it's not disabled.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drink Thoughts
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature looks into the pit

Effect Ephemeral energies pour from the creature's head, and the creature must attempt a DC 30 Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Failure The creature is Stupefied 2 for 1 hour and loses 1 minute of recent memories (a memory of the GM's choosing within the last 24 hours).

Critical Failure As failure, but Stupefied 3.
